facts.fact: 她被锁上手腕、腰与脚踝三处镣铐，独自走过城堡大厅去见国王。
facts.anchor: Cold metal clanked around my wrists, my waist, and between my ankles.

facts.fact: 国王恢复王号后换了发色：原是一头银白细发，如今成了垂过下颌的深栗色卷发，令她怀疑换了人。
facts.anchor: his hair, which was once a fine silver-white, had turned a wavy dark chestnut brown

facts.fact: 她开口讨回昨夜落下的另一只靴子，取过来隔着长袜重新穿上。
facts.anchor: I reached over to take the shoe and slipped it on over my stockings.

facts.fact: 国王低声断言她「借来的心」里的魔法尚未消散——这正是她昨夜能感知到刺客的原因。
facts.anchor: The magic in your borrowed heart has not yet dissipated.

facts.fact: 国王承认整场舞会是引刺客现身的陷阱，并命令她指认企图行刺他的囚犯。
facts.anchor: “It was a trap,” he repeated in confirmation, his tone bored.

facts.fact: 五名囚犯被傀儡守卫用铁链拖进王座厅，在御座前被按成一排。
facts.anchor: as five prisoners were dragged into the hall

facts.fact: 她指认出昨夜行刺的那名女子后，国王点头下令把她押上绞架。
facts.anchor: “It’s her.” The king tilted his head in a slight nod. “Take her to the gallows.”

facts.fact: 她抗议国王食言，国王却抬手一挥，下令把囚犯全部杀掉。
facts.anchor: He lifted his hand, then gave a slight wave. “Kill them all.”

relations.fact: 叙述者与国王曾「心相连」，彼此能感知对方的感受（本章以过去时陈述这段联结），她自认像飞蛾般被他吸引。
relations.anchor: When our hearts were linked, I could feel what he felt. He could feel what I felt.

numbers.fact: 「几周前」（A few weeks ago）国王的手下偷听到针对他的阴谋——这一时长说法出自国王之口，指王廷追查叛徒期间。
numbers.anchor: A few weeks ago, my men overheard a scheme against me.
